name: Christiaan ('Chris') Barnard
summary: South African cardiac surgeon who performed the first human-to-human heart transplant.

name: Groote Schuur Hospital
summary: Major teaching hospital of the University of Cape Town where Barnard worked.

name: University of Cape Town
summary: University where Barnard studied medicine and later worked.

name: University of Minnesota
summary: University where Barnard gained surgical experience in open heart surgery.

name: Beaufort West
summary: Rural town in South Africa where Barnard was born.

name: Cape Town
summary: City in South Africa where Barnard worked and lived.

name: Minneapolis
summary: City in the USA where Barnard trained under Wangensteen.

name: Richmond
summary: City where Barnard gained experience in immunosuppressive therapy.

name: Oklahoma City
summary: City where Barnard helped establish a heart transplantation program.

name: Louis Washkansky
summary: First recipient of a human-to-human heart transplant.

name: Denise Darvall
summary: First human heart donor.

name: Philip Blaiberg
summary: Second recipient of a heart transplant by Barnard.

name: Marius Barnard
summary: Younger brother of Christiaan Barnard and a cardiac surgeon.

name: C. Walton Lillehei
summary: Pioneer in open heart surgery and Barnard's mentor in Minneapolis.

name: Owen Wangensteen
summary: Legendary professor under whom Barnard studied at Minnesota.

name: Norman Shumway
summary: Researcher who developed the operative technique for heart transplantation.

name: David Hume
summary: Head of the transplant program in Richmond where Barnard learnt immunosuppression.

name: Richard Lower
summary: Researcher in Richmond who trained with Shumway.

name: Velva Schrire
summary: Professor of cardiology who selected the first transplant patient.

name: Jacques Losman
summary: Junior colleague who designed the heterotopic heart transplantation operation.

name: Winston Wicomb
summary: Junior research colleague who introduced hypothermic perfusion of the donor heart.

name: Dimitri Novitzky
summary: Junior surgical colleague who studied brain death pathophysiology.

name: University of Cape Town prosthesis
summary: Prosthetic heart valve designed and implanted by Barnard.
